title: Document and test shared federation credit saturation during long executor holds
outcome: Document and test shared federation credit saturation during long executor holds
acceptance: Documentation and focused coverage show that deferred executor associations retain one of the shared four per-peer credits, with truthful 429 behavior for other routes and release on durable association or terminal refusal.

Controls distinguish legitimate transient hold saturation from leaked terminal credits and unknown effects; full gate and independent review pass without adding a timebox or separate permit pool absent a separately approved design.
